verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an Agent Skill folder with dependency-free Python tools and marketplace/plugin install commands. A skill package that exposes CLI tools could plausibly version that interface and publish a deprecation policy, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack mentions API versioning, release versioning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
